description: Class representing a base list field.

AddOption.description: Adds new option to list options.

AddWidget.description: Adds new widget - visual representation for field

GetAllWidgets.description: Gets array with widgets of the current field.

returns.description: returns emptry array if the field is not added to the document.

GetOptions.description: Gets all options from list options.

IsCommitOnSelChange.description: Checks if field can commit on selection change.

IsReadOnly.description: Checks if field is read only

MoveOption.description: Moves option to specified position in list options.

params.description: The current index of the option to move.
params.name: currentIndex

params.description: The target index for the option.
params.name: newIndex

SetCommitOnSelChange.description: Sets whether the field commits changes immediately after selection changes.

params.description: Specifies whether selection changes are committed immediately.
params.name: commitOnSelectionChange

SetFullName.description: Sets new field name if possible.

params.description: The new full name for the field.
params.name: name

params.description: The new partial name for the field.
params.name: name

params.description: Specifies whether the field is read-only.
params.name: readOnly

params.description: Specifies whether the field is required.
params.name: required

params.description: The new value for the field.
params.name: value

params.description: The indexes of the selected values.
params.name: valueIndexes
